next.discoverBody: Twelve quick scenarios to explore the kind of work you enjoy.
next.routeBody: Answer three short preference questions and pick the route you want to explore.
next.pathBody: We will suggest courses from the catalogue that match your route.
next.unitCv: Finish {{id}} Unit {{unit}} and save a CV draft
next.apply: Your path is complete. Explore opportunities
next.applyBody: Use your course evidence when you apply.
next.programmeBody: Join a trainer-led class at a training centre near you. Online courses stay open while you wait.

dash.greeting: Hi {{name}}, ready for your next step?
dash.subtitle: Discover your strengths, build your skills and take your next step.
dash.discoveryBody: Find out which kinds of work you enjoy, then explore the routes and courses that may suit you.
dash.noPlanBody: Choose a route after career discovery and we will suggest courses from the catalogue.
dash.noCohort: You are not assigned to a training cohort yet. Explore self-paced courses while you wait.
dash.noUpcoming: No upcoming sessions in your cohort right now. Check My Cohort and Sessions for past materials.
dash.noOpps: No open opportunities for your route right now. New sample opportunities appear here.
dash.oppsNote: Applying is free and never requires points.
dash.mentorReady: You have enough points to book a 30 minute mentor session ({{cost}} points), or use a programme allocation if you have one.
dash.mentorLocked: A mentor session uses {{cost}} points or a programme allocation. Complete courses and practical tasks to earn points.
dash.libraryBody: The general course library is open to everyone. You can start any course before choosing a route.
dash.discoveryDoneBody: Revisit your preferences, change your route or retake the exercise at any time.

discovery.title: Career discovery
discovery.subtitle: A short scenario exercise to help you explore the kinds of work you may enjoy.
discovery.introTitle: What kind of work do you enjoy?
discovery.introBody: You will see 12 everyday scenarios. For each one, choose the response that is most like you. There are no right or wrong answers.
discovery.factTimeBody: Take your time. You can save and come back later.
discovery.factQuestionsBody: Four options each. Pick the one most like you.
discovery.factNoPassBody: It does not decide admission or employment eligibility.
discovery.illustrative: This exercise supports exploration. It is an illustrative demonstration, not a validated psychometric test, and your results never decide admission or employment eligibility.
discovery.completedOn: You completed career discovery on {{date}}. Retaking it keeps your learning and points.
discovery.presetHint: Fills the 12 answers for the signed-in demo profile and opens the review screen.
discovery.presetToast: Preset answers added. Review them before you submit.
discovery.pickOne: Choose the response that is most like you.
discovery.savedToast: Saved. You can resume at question {{n}}.
discovery.reviewBody: Check your answers. You can change any of them before you submit.
discovery.readyNote: All 12 answered. Submit to see your results.

results.title: Your results and route
results.subtitle: Your preferences, the routes you can explore and the learning that can help.
results.noneBody: Complete career discovery to see your preferences and the routes you can explore.
results.balancedBody: Your answers are spread across several kinds of work. Explore the routes below and see what feels right.
results.startingPoint: These results are a starting point for exploration
results.chartNote: Each answer adds 2 points to one preference. Total: 24 points.
results.prefsBody: How you want to earn shapes the recommended route. Your profile only suggests roles and learning.
results.recLine: Recommended from your earning preference: {{route}}. You can choose any route.
results.recMore: Answer all three questions to complete your preferences.
results.recPending: Answer the earning question to see a recommended route. You can choose any route.

routeLine.employment: A regular role with a team and a salary.
routeLine.enterprise: Test an idea and build your own small business.
routeLine.freelance: Projects or part-time work for clients.

whyRoute.employment: Employment offers a clear structure, a team to learn from and a regular income.
whyRoute.enterprise: Entrepreneurship lets you test your own idea with real customers, step by step.
whyRoute.freelance: Freelancing and part-time work give flexibility and let you build a portfolio of real work.

results.whyDims: Your strongest preferences, {{a}} and {{b}}, are useful here.
results.whyEarning: It also matches how you said you want to earn.
results.secondaryHint: We keep it on your profile so you can explore it later.
results.changeLater: You can change this decision later. Completed learning and points always stay.
results.noPrediction: Routes and suggestions support exploration only. They are not a prediction of being hired or of business success.

path.noRouteTitle: Choose a route to build your path
path.noRouteBody: Your learning path uses your discovery results and the route you choose. You can still explore the general library now.

explain.employment: Start with communication and digital skills, then prepare a CV and practise a customer-service interview.
explain.enterprise: Start with communication and digital skills, then test your idea with customers, plan the money and prepare a pitch.
explain.freelance: Start with communication and digital skills, then define your service, build a portfolio and write a focused proposal.

path.explainBalanced: Your preferences are balanced, so this path keeps your options open.
path.journeyNote: Self-paced courses, practical outputs and, if you are assigned to a cohort, trainer-led sessions.

reasons.C01: A starting point to understand your strengths and the three ways of earning.
reasons.C02: Digital confidence you will use in every course and job.
reasons.C03: You enjoy helping people: this builds clear communication and teamwork.
reasons.C04: Optional: plan your week and keep a healthy routine while you learn.
reasons.C05: Turn your real experience into an honest, specific CV.
reasons.C06: Practise customer-service interview answers with clear examples.
reasons.C07: Describe a real customer problem before you build anything.
reasons.C08: Understand costs, pricing and a simple cash plan.
reasons.C09: Explain your offer and reach your first customers.
reasons.C10: Connect a skill you already have to a realistic client need.
reasons.C11: Show your work with honest samples and write focused proposals.
reasons.C12: Deliver client work in stages and handle change requests.
reasons.C13: A practical taster of service desks and simple office records.
reasons.C14: Optional: spreadsheet skills useful for organised, reliable work.
reasons.C15: Create original sample content for your portfolio.
reasons.C16: Prepare a two-minute pitch and a support application.

path.readiness: Completed learning adds to your readiness evidence. It does not guarantee a job, a client or funding.

library.title: Course library
library.subtitle: Sixteen short courses across five groups. Most take 30 to 50 minutes.
library.openNote: General courses are open to everyone. Trainer-led cohort sessions remain restricted to assigned learners.
library.certReviewed: Certificate after your trainer's review (centre class)
library.noResultsBody: Try a different search word or clear the filters to see all 16 courses.
library.tasterNote: Illustrative technical tasters. They show how practical content could be organised and are not occupational qualifications.

course.notFoundBody: This course is not in the demonstration catalogue. Open the library to choose another course.
course.accessOpen: This general course is open to all learners. Trainer-led cohort sessions remain restricted to assigned learners.
course.accessCohort: This course is part of your centre class. Your trainer reviews the practical task and the centre approves the certificate.
course.outcomes: What you will be able to do
course.practicalReviewed: Reviewed by your trainer because you are in an assigned cohort.
course.finalCheckBody: {{n}} questions. Pass mark {{pass}} percent. {{attempts}} attempts, then trainer support.
course.noResources: This course uses the activities inside each unit. Templates are available in related courses.

template.hint: Open, edit and download as text
template.description: An editable sample template. Changes stay on this screen until you copy or download them.
template.copyFailed: Copy is not available here. Select the text and copy it manually.

player.openTranscript: Play sample lesson preview: {{title}}. Opens the transcript
player.readingNote: This sample preview is presented as a transcript.
player.sumPractiseBody: Work on a short activity that builds towards the course output: {{output}}
player.sumReflectBody: Note one thing you will use this week and one question for your trainer or mentor.
player.toQuiz: Mark as done and take the knowledge check

quiz.title: Final knowledge check
quiz.rules: {{n}} questions. You need {{pass}} percent to pass. You have {{attempts}} attempts; after that your trainer can support you.
quiz.unitsLeft: Tip: finish all four units first. The course is complete only when the units, the knowledge check and the practical task are done.
quiz.notYet: Not yet. You need {{pass}} percent. Review the feedback and try again.
quiz.supportTitle: Let us get you some support
quiz.supportBody: You have used both demo attempts. Your best score was {{best}} percent. A trainer or mentor can go through the units with you before the next attempt.
quiz.shortcutDone: Course requirements completed for the demonstration

practical.title: Practical task
practical.label: Your short response
practical.hintSelf: Write a few sentences. This counts as soon as you submit it.
practical.hintReviewed: Write a few sentences. A trainer will review it.
practical.sentReview: Submitted. A trainer will review it.
practical.waiting: Submitted. A trainer will review it before the course is complete.
practical.returned: Your trainer returned this task with comments. Update your response and submit again.
practical.doneSelf: Submitted. Your practical task counts towards completion.

complete.title: Course completed
complete.body: Great work. Your course evidence is saved and adds to your readiness. It does not guarantee a job.

cert.title: Certificate
cert.heading: Certificate of completion
cert.presented: This demonstration certificate is presented to
cert.disclaimer: Sample certificate for demonstration only. Recognition of certificates is to be confirmed by UNICEF.
cert.printHint: Use Print to save a simple printable copy.

missing.quiz: Pass the final knowledge check (80 percent)

waiting.pendingReview: Your course is complete. Your trainer reviews it next and recommends the certificate.
waiting.recommended: Your trainer has recommended your certificate. The centre approves it next.
waiting.approved: The centre has approved your certificate. It will be issued shortly.

progress.title: Progress and rewards
progress.subtitle: Points, badges and your learning and career progress, kept as separate measures.
progress.balanceNote: Use 100 points for a mentor session. Learning and applications never need points.
progress.noLeaderboard: Your points are private to you. There is no public leaderboard or ranking.
progress.outcomesHint: Confirmed job starts, assignments or enterprise support
progress.separate: Points, learning progress and career outcomes are separate measures. Points never show competency or hiring eligibility.
progress.badgesNote: Badges show completed demo activities, not guaranteed competency or hiring eligibility.
progress.noPoints: No points yet. Complete your profile and career discovery to earn your first points.
progress.rulesNote: Each activity counts once. Repeat clicks never add points twice.

assessment.condition: Once; retakes do not earn more

mentor.condition: Deducted once on a successful booking; returned if cancelled before the session
